required_outputs: daily cross-sectional Spearman Rank-IC for D+5 and D+10 economic returns
stage_1_factor_screening.promotion_rule: A factor family may enter combination research only if its directional behavior is materially stable across date blocks and is not driven by one short interval or a tiny security subset.
stage_1_factor_screening.exact_numeric_promotion_thresholds: NOT_YET_FROZEN; must be preregistered before results are consumed for promotion.

method_constraints: small candidate family; no unrestricted parameter sweep
complexity must be recorded and penalized
compare incremental value versus simpler parent specification
leave-one-subsector/industry sensitivity where taxonomy is available
B3 legacy family retained as negative control

leakage_controls: feature row at D uses only D-vintage or earlier retained source
max_bar_date must equal D for a prospective-equivalent daily source
U/E membership and evidence use only information legally available before D
D->T economic return endpoints come from the same T-vintage snapshot under frozen economic-price semantics
future delisting/listing metadata cannot alter historical membership
same-day filing evidence is excluded unless availability timestamp proves it was available before the signal cutoff
statistical_controls: date is the primary dependence block for bootstrap/resampling
do not treat stock-day rows as independent observations
report effective date count and security concentration
multiple candidate variants within a family must be enumerated before evaluation
no optional stopping based on interim attractive results
failed variants remain in the research ledger
benchmark_controls: report appropriate broad index benchmark where available
AI-Core peer benchmark may be supplemental but cannot be the only comparator

promotion_boundary.retrospective_success_can_do: qualify a fully frozen V2.8.x strategy candidate for a new prospective activation
promotion_boundary.retrospective_success_cannot_do: certify profitability, open S4/S5/S6, or authorize live trading
